coverage: continuous shared sun, moon, ambient, exposure, shadow, water, and emissive activation state
one screen-space cast direction per frame across hills, mountains, volcanoes, forest, jungle, shore bodies, and river clutter
normal-driven self shading plus neighboring cast shadows for every raised renderer-owned class
fixed stylized shadow length by caster height with phase-driven direction, strength, and color
deterministic noon, 18:00, midnight, and 06:00 renders at both Civ III zoom scales

visible_light_boundary.l13a: global environment and non-visual emissive policy only
visible_light_boundary.first_visible_fixture: L17 cities using real city windows, lamps, emissives, and analytic attachments
visible_light_boundary.later_improvements: each improvement gate may add only source-backed lights owned by that improvement
visible_light_boundary.roads: inherit the environment; no invented streetlights in L14

ownership_intent.object_emissives_and_lights: remain absent until their own approved lab and integration gates
ownership_intent.retained_layers: Civ III overlays, labels, fog, selection, HUD, and UI

cache_inputs: viewport, zoom, scroll, clip, and wrap representation

fallback: If I13A cannot resolve the approved environment state, fail the custom frame visibly; never relight retained Civ III layers or replay native map terrain.
